description: The Nordic-Baltic working group on statistics and definitions, formed by the telecom regulators of the Nordic and Baltic countries, produces a joint annual statistic, 'Telecommunication markets in the Nordic and Baltic countries'. It compares the development of the national telecom markets using common definitions, covering broadband, mobile and fixed telephony, TV distribution, the market shares of the largest companies, and revenue and investment. Each year's report is published as a presentation (for example the 2024 publication, a PDF on the Danish agency's site), and the underlying figures are available on the statistics portal of the Swedish Post and Telecom Authority (PTS). Coverage: Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland, Iceland, Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania. Format and access: PDF reports and an online statistics portal, free. Caveats: harmonised definitions still leave national differences; the PTS portal refused automated requests, so its data formats were not checked. Simulation uses: comparable demand, subscription and investment inputs for regional telecom models, and context for cross-border connectivity studies. Related records: the Danish telecom statistics give the Danish national series in more detail, and the ITU indicators cover the rest of the world.
